mapper.select: SELECT YEAR(o.PlacedAt) AS PlacedYear, o.CompanyId AS CompanyId, CASE WHEN o.CustomerId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS KeyAccount, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM {{schema}}.ShopOrders AS o WHERE o.CustomerId > 0 GROUP BY YEAR(o.PlacedAt), o.CompanyId, CASE WHEN o.CustomerId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
